research_scope: Null race_restriction CaC-usable skills; five frontier records.

records.name: Die Die Missile Barrage
records.evidence: Direct Xenoverse skill reference explicitly states 'Usable by: All races'. This establishes unrestricted race eligibility, so canonical null is retained rather than inventing a restrictive value.

records.name: Super Vanishing Ball
records.evidence: Direct Xenoverse skill reference explicitly states 'Usable by: All races'. Current Xenoverse 2 reference establishes it as a CaC-usable Ki Blast Ultimate obtained from the Skill Shop; no narrower restriction exists.

records.name: Super Volley
records.evidence: Historical repository recovery establishes the identity as CaC-usable. The Future Warrior technique reference places the Future Warrior's learnable skills in a list that includes CaC techniques and separately marks explicit race restrictions when present; no explicit race/gender/form restriction was found for Super Volley.

records.name: Swallow Shot
records.evidence: Historical repository recovery establishes Swallow Shot as explicitly CaC-usable. Its Videl/Dragon Ball Super association and Hero of Justice Pack 2 provenance do not establish a CaC race restriction; no explicit race/gender/form condition was found.

records.name: Thunder Eraser
records.evidence: Current direct reference establishes Future Warrior acquisition through the Skill Shop and identifies Super 17/Android 17 as notable users. Character ownership and acquisition route do not establish a race restriction, and no explicit CaC race/gender/form condition was found.

policy: Only explicit CaC eligibility wording establishing a narrower race/gender/form condition can populate race_restriction; explicit all-races wording supports retaining null.
